title: Center for Epidemiologic Studies Depression Scale
description: 20 items about the past week rated 0–3 by frequency.

holder.name: Lenore Sawyer Radloff / National Institute of Mental Health (no first-party terms page found)

citation.text: Radloff LS (1977). The CES-D Scale: a self-report depression scale for research in the general population. Applied Psychological Measurement 1(3):385–401.

scoring.text: Sum of the 20 items (0–60) after reversing the positive items 4, 8, 12 and 16; 16 or more is the usual cut-off. Scoring here follows the published literature; check it against the manual or form your lab holds before publishing.
